user.title: Connect a Lumi curtain
user.description: Supports lumi.curtain.hmcn02. Close Mi Home and the Bluetooth control page, then enter the curtain's Bluetooth address and 32-byte LTMK (64 hexadecimal characters). A connectable Bluetooth adapter with ATT MTU of at least 71 is required.

reauth_confirm.title: Update curtain credentials
reauth_confirm.description: The curtain rejected its saved LTMK. Enter the current 32-byte LTMK.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up discovered curtain
bluetooth_confirm.description: Found curtain {address}. Close Mi Home and other apps connected to the device, then enter its 32-byte LTMK.

error.invalid_address: Enter a Bluetooth address such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.invalid_ltmk: The LTMK must be exactly 64 hexadecimal characters.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to communicate with the curtain. Check Bluetooth range and available proxy connection slots, and close other apps connected to the curtain. After a failed login, wait about 20 seconds before retrying.
error.unsupported_mtu: The Bluetooth connection MTU is too small. Check the adapter or proxy firmware for support of ATT MTU 71 or greater.

abort.not_supported: This device is not a supported Lumi curtain.
abort.not_connectable: This Bluetooth source only receives advertisements. Use an adapter or proxy that supports active connections.
